text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. The season for the 
major event to hone the minds and bodies 
of the Umamusume had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes to the biggest event of 
summer, it has to be the Comi...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... this year it's the Japan Dirt 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's not like every other year where I'd 
just prostrate myself before the Umamusume 
cosplayers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em, Digi-tan. This summer, I'll 
uncover the true essence of the 
Umamusumes' sheer preciousness! And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And making the book in between!

It looks like we'll be having a fulfilling 
time, both on and off duty.
